verses.translation: This Psalm is a genuine one of David, though supernumerary, composed when he fought in single combat with Goliad. I was small among my brethren, and youngest in my father's house: I tended my father's sheep.

translations.ron: Mic eram între fraţii mei şi tânăr în casa tatălui meu; păşteam oile tatălui meu.

verses.translation: My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a psaltery.

translations.ron: Mâinile mele au făcut harpa şi degetele mele au întocmit psaltirea.

verses.translation: And who shall tell my Lord? the Lord himself, he himself hears.

translations.ron: Şi cine va vesti Domnului meu? Însuşi Domnul, Însuşi va auzi.

verses.translation: He sent forth his angel, and took me from my father's sheep, and he anointed me with the oil of his anointing.

translations.ron: El a trimis pe îngerul Lui şi m-a luat de la oile tatălui meu şi m-a uns cu untdelemnul ungerii Lui.

verses.translation: My brothers were handsome and tall; but the Lord did not take pleasure in them.

translations.ron: Fraţii mei erau buni şi mari şi nu a binevoit întru dânşii Domnul.

verses.translation: I went forth to meet the Philistine; and he cursed me by his idols.

translations.ron: Ieşit-am în întâmpinarea celui de alt neam şi m-a blestemat cu idolii lui.

verses.translation: But I drew his own sword, and beheaded him, and removed reproach from the children of Israel.

translations.ron: Iar eu, smulgându-i sabia, i-am taiat capul şi am ridicat ocara de pe fii lui Israel.
